title: Your Gas Car Has 10 Gears. Most EVs Have ONE. Why? ⚙️⚡ #shorts

scenes.text: Some gas cars have ten gears. Most electric cars have just one. Why?
A gas engine makes no power at zero rpm, and only pulls well in a narrow band of speeds. Gears keep it inside that band.
An electric motor makes its full torque from a standstill, right from zero rpm.
And it spins much faster. A Tesla Model 3 motor turns over eighteen thousand rpm at top speed.
So one fixed reduction gear, about nine to one, covers everything from zero to top speed.
A few performance EVs, like the Porsche Taycan, add a second gear: a short one, about fifteen to one, for launches.
Fewer parts, no shifting, smooth pull. Would you miss changing gears? Follow EV Drive for daily car tech.
